# AV-TEC India — Audio Visual & Event Technology

> AV-TEC is a premier audio-visual, stage lighting, video LED wall, trussing, and event production engineering company based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India, operating since 1992.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Entity**: AV-TEC (AV-TEC Audio Visual & Event Technology)
- **Established**: 1992 (30+ Years of Live Event Operations)
- **Headquarters**: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- **Phone**: +91 79757 84962
- **Emails**: ilangovan@avtecindia.com, balaji@avtecindia.com
- **Website**: https://www.avtecindia.com
- **Google Maps**: https://www.google.com/maps/place/AV-TEC/@12.9868205,77.5990784,17z/

## Primary Capabilities & Services
1. **Audio Systems**: D&B Audiotechnik Q Series & GSL Line Array, Martin Audio W8LM, DiGiCo SD consoles, Yamaha RIVAGE/DM3 mixers, SC48, Shure Axient/QLXD digital wireless, Sennheiser IEMs, OSL Digital Conference Mics, Clear Comms wireless intercoms.
2. **Stage Lighting**: Robe MegaPointe, Clay Paky Sharpy, Astera AX1 wireless tubes, Avolites Arena/Tiger Touch II, MA Lighting grandMA, LED moving head washes & profiles.
3. **Video & LED Walls**: P2.6 Indoor Ultra-Fine Pitch LED walls, P6 Outdoor high-brightness LED video displays, Blackmagic ATEM 4K switchers, Novastar video processors, Disguise media servers, broadcast camera chains.
4. **Trussing & Rigging**: Prolyte H40V heavy-duty aluminum truss grids, certified roof canopy structures, CM Lodestar electric chain hoists, Broadweigh wireless load monitoring.
5. **Tech Consultancy**: Acoustic modeling, CAD stage & rig design, signal flow architecture, technical rider compliance, power distribution planning.
6. **Installs & Integrations**: Boardroom AV systems, corporate auditoriums, broadcast studios, places of worship, luxury venue permanent installations (Crestron, QSC, Extron).
7. **Sales & Distribution**: Authorized rental & supply partner for premier pro audio, lighting, and video hardware brands across India.
8. **Production Management**: Turnkey technical management, FOH sound engineering, light operators, video engineers, certified rigger crews for concerts, corporate conventions, and international summits.

## Geographic Coverage
- **Primary Hub**: Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka
- **Regional Coverage**: Chennai, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Goa, Delhi NCR, Cochin, Pune
- **Pan-India Operations**: Complete mobile production setups dispatched across India and international event destinations.
